subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — provisional PO and corrected SKU lines
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@novaedge.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: request for provisional PO and spend cap

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking our onboarding request. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial line items CSV. We need a provisional PO to start provisioning (we're targeting a soft go-live next week). Key asks:
- Temporary / provisional PO number so our finance team can reconcile invoices
- Spend cap set to $75,000 for the initial quarter (we listed $50k on the form by mistake)
- One SKU (NE-API-V1) should be for 3 units, but the CSV currently shows 1 unit — attached for correction.

Could you confirm what you need from us to get a TEMP PO issued? Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
Head of Procurement
NovaEdge Systems
Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf, nova_lineitems_v1.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: request for provisional PO and spend cap

Hi Samantha — welcome and thanks for the form. A few quick items before procurement can issue a provisional PO:

1) Missing Tax ID (EIN) on the onboarding form — we need that for vendor record creation.
2) You mentioned $75,000 spend cap in your note but the submitted form shows $50,000. Please confirm which is correct.
3) The SKU mapping in the CSV appears inconsistent with our ledger codex (NE-API-V1 -> expected SKU code NEAPI_001). If you can re-send a corrected CSV with the intended quantities we can avoid a line-item reconciliation later.

Monica — can we provision a provisional PO (placeholder) while we wait for the corrected form/EIN? If so, can you confirm the format we should use for the TEMP PO and any ledger tags to attach so NovaEdge can start onboarding?

Samantha — if you can send the filled form with EIN and the corrected lineitems file I will nudge procurement for an expedited temp PO.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Onboarding — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO and corrected SKU lines

Hi all — looping in procurement operations. We can issue a provisional PO to unblock NovaEdge while vendor creation completes, but we need the EIN and corrected SKU/qtys no later than EOD tomorrow to avoid manual reconciliation on billing. Proposed steps:

- TEMP PO: PO-TEMP-8342 (this will show as provisional in our ledger).
- Ledger tag: INT-ONBOARD-2025 / cost center 4701.
- Spend cap: setting to $75,000 pending your confirmation (Samantha). We will place a soft hold at $75k and alert if usage approaches 90%.
- Line items: I noticed NE-API-V1 mapped to two different SKU codes in your CSV and quantities differ. Please download the attached template (nova_lineitems_v2.csv), correct the SKU column to match your internal catalog codes, and re-upload.

Attachments: nova_lineitems_v2.csv (template)

If you confirm EIN + corrected CSV, I'll push PO-TEMP-8342 into the system and share the PO stub (PDF) and a DocuSign link for the onboarding SOW (if applicable). Rishi — flagging for finance review in case we need to bump temporary credit beyond the standard 60-day provisional.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Procurement Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 07:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO and corrected SKU lines

Thanks Monica — attached is the corrected onboarding_form_filled.pdf with our EIN (12-3456789) and the updated nova_lineitems_v2.csv. Apologies for the mix-up on SKU codes — we exported from an older system and a few rows retained deprecated codes. All quantities are updated: NE-API-V1 = 3 units.

We confirm spend cap should be $75,000 for the quarter. We do need the provisional PO before Thursday to meet our internal provisioning window — is that doable? We also need the PO stub to attach to our internal ticket.

If there's any missing detail, please call me at +1 (415) 555-0198.

Best,
Samantha

Attachments: onboarding_form_filled.pdf, nova_lineitems_v2.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO and corrected SKU lines

Samantha — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. Monica will push PO-TEMP-8342 into the system by EOD and attach it to the vendor record. Quick notes:

- Finance (Rishi) will review the provisional credit threshold; we will confirm if any additional approvals are needed by tomorrow morning.
- Please sign the SOW via the DocuSign link once Monica shares it — that will speed final vendor creation and allow us to move the provisional PO to a formal PO number.
- Related: HubSpot deal is updated here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8342 (Karthik has added the corrected lineitems as an internal note).

We will send the PO stub (PDF) after Monica completes the push. If you don't see it by 5pm PT, flag me and I'll escalate.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Onboarding — Redwood Inference
